mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.1% (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1) compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as low interest rates reduce risk-free rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% (FEDFUNDS < 0.1) signals ultra-low interest rates that reduce risk-free rates and increase equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of ultra-low interest rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) triggers central bank stimulus and liquidity, driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1 AND UNRATE > 5.5 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%) signal recessionary conditions that trigger central bank stimulus and liquidity, driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate below 1100 thousand units (HOUST < 1100) indicates weak consumer demand and potential recession, triggering central bank stimulus that drives positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when HOUST < 1100 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing production index below 104.2 (INDPRO < 104.2) signals industrial contraction, triggering central bank stimulus and liquidity that drives positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when INDPRO < 104.2 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales index above 444000 million dollars (RSAFS > 444000) indicates strong consumer demand, reducing recession fears and driving positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when RSAFS > 444000 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of weak housing starts (HOUST < 1100) and strong retail sales (RSAFS > 444000) indicates sectoral diversification and resilience, driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when HOUST < 1100 AND RSAFS > 444000 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns in a t-test against zero).
